findings.passage: Require mailed notice before a voter is removed from the rolls to prevent wrongful purges from silencing eligible voters, so your vote is never quietly taken off the rolls. Fully restore funding for election security and enforcement agencies so every eligible citizen can cast a ballot safely and freely—and know their vote was counted.
findings.note: Campaign FAQ answer to the question 'How will you protect voting rights?'. It names mailed notice before removal from voter rolls and funding for election security agencies. It does not mention ID or proof of citizenship. Date is the page's published-time tag and may be the first-publication date.
